problem.name: AIsing Programming Contest 2020 - A: Number of Multiples
problem.statement_summary: Given integers L, R, d, count multiples of d in inclusive range [L,R].

submission.source_form: Free-form Fortran source stored with .f extension
submission.original_compile_status: not independently rerun with GNU Fortran 9.2.1

local_build_review.default_form_check: Failed as expected: .f selected fixed-form parsing, but the source uses free-form syntax.
local_build_review.scope: This is a local rebuild with GNU Fortran 14.3.0 and an explicit free-form flag. It does not reproduce the original GNU Fortran 9.2.1 judge environment.

oracle_review.official_examples: The three fixtures match the official AtCoder problem statement.
oracle_review.additional_fixtures: Two boundary/offset fixtures are derived from the stated mathematical specification.
oracle_review.prototype_translation_screen: Passed all five fixtures against the project's Fortran-subset interpreter and generated JavaScript runtime.
oracle_review.independence_limit: The official examples are independent reference outputs; the two additional fixture outputs were derived from the problem definition. The prototype interpreter is not an independent oracle.
